item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:45 HKT 10/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Yinxing will move across the northern part of the South China Sea today. Under the combined effect of Yinxing and the northeast monsoon, it will be windy with a few squally showers over the coast of Guangdong today. Seas will be rough with swells. With Yinxing turning southwestwards gradually, departing the coastal areas and weakening, the weather will improve over the region in the following couple of days. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Toraji over the seas east of the Philippines will move towards the vicinity of Luzon and intensify gradually today and tomorrow. It will then enter the central and northern parts of the South China Sea, and have a higher chance to move towards the coast of southern China. However, there are uncertainties in its movement and intensity. Under the combined effect of Toraji and the northeast monsoon, the weather will become unsettled and it will be windier over the coast of Guangdong midweek this week.
